note: The main banks: no ranking was read and only Azizi Bank, whose sheet was already found, was tried this time, for want of the research's budget. Azizi Bank's credit card charges sheet (Titanium and Platinum), read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Titanium alone): both cards are in US dollars and issued against a fixed deposit of 125% of the limit (the Titanium for limits of 1,000 to 4,999 dollars, the Platinum from 5,000), a condition the game doesn't check. Each costs its issue fee (100 or 200 dollars) and then its annual fee (100 or 200), the first year free, written as a yearly fee waived for the first year; bears 24% a year on the outstanding amount; charges 2% for cash from Azizi Bank's ATMs (2.5% with a minimum at other ATMs, not written); adds a forex mark-up of 'around 3.5%', written as 3.5%; and charges a late payment fee and an over-limit fee each of 50 dollars on the Titanium and 25 on the Platinum, as printed. The sheet states no minimum payment or grace period. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): no bank was added. Tried: Afghanistan International Bank's card page lists its Mastercard Classic, Visa, Titanium and Platinum credit cards with their yearly fees (25 to 50 dollars, the first year free) and a repayment window of 10 days after the statement, but no interest rate, so none is written (a card's rate can't be left out); Afghan United Bank's home page linked a debit card application and general terms, and its cards page wasn't read for want of time; Bank Millie Afghan answered with a Cloudflare check; Ghazanfar Bank didn't answer.
